rungs.description: Static snapshot; memory is files in context.
rungs.name: Static snapshot

rungs.description: Feedback distilled into retrievable rules; no weight change.
rungs.name: Gradient-free memory
rungs.observables: pass^1 lift with memory; hold rate; transfer across models

research.name: frozen weights memory
research.snippet: We show that this feedback is a sufficient signal for continual learning when the frozen model is paired with an external memory that distils each episode into retrievable natural-language rules.
research.subject: frozen_weights_memory

rungs.description: One objective, all users; the model updates from aggregate usage.
rungs.name: Population-level online learning

production.name: Anysphere
production.snippet: Our approach is unusual because it involves rolling out new models to users frequently throughout the day and using that data for training.
production.subject: anysphere

production.name: Baseten
production.snippet: The pipeline extracts hidden states directly from live inference and uses them to train the draft model on the fly, eliminating the need to store data offline.
production.subject: baseten_draft

rungs.description: Adapters per deployment, refreshed hourly to weekly, routed and versioned.
rungs.name: Per-customer adapters on a cadence
rungs.observables: cl_refresh_cadence_hours; cl_adapters_per_product; per-customer lift over time

production.name: Trajectory
production.snippet: a pipeline that takes a freshly trained LoRA adapter and puts it behind a live, A/B routed, fully provenanced endpoint in roughly an hour. That is enough to run continual learning in production today
production.subject: trajectory

rungs.description: Firm knowledge internalised in weights with measured retention.
rungs.name: Organisation knowledge in weights
rungs.observables: cl_forgetting_retention; firm-knowledge lift; cost per query

research.name: engram harvey
research.snippet: By combining its knowledge of the workspace with search, it solves tasks more effectively with an order of magnitude lower cost-per-query ($0.13 / 30% all-pass for our agent, vs. $1.32 / 25% all-pass for Opus 4.8).
research.subject: engram_harvey

research.name: harvey tenet
research.snippet: Starting from a Kimi K3 base, we worked with Fireworks to post-train our model via asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) in realistic legal work settings.
research.subject: harvey_tenet

rungs.description: Updates from individual sessions persist and pool without forgetting.
rungs.name: Per-session weight updates that persist and pool
rungs.observables: a lab release branded continual or online learning; a forgetting benchmark; per-user weight divergence

research.name: ttt layers
research.snippet: Since the hidden state is updated by training even on test sequences, our layers are called Test-Time Training (TTT) layers.
research.subject: ttt_layers

research.name: titans
research.snippet: We present a new neural long-term memory module that learns to memorize historical context and helps attention to attend to the current context while utilizing long past information.
research.subject: titans

research.name: baseten rank1 lora
research.snippet: Continuously (or close to continuously) merging rank-1 LoRA adapters into the model on the same GPUs running inference felt like the right answer to that to us.
research.subject: baseten_rank1_lora

research.name: tml on policy distillation
research.snippet: This generalizes to a broader set of continual learning tasks, which require acquiring new knowledge without degrading prior capabilities.
research.subject: tml_on_policy_distillation

research.name: nested learning hope
research.snippet: We test and validate Nested Learning through a proof-of-concept, self-modifying architecture that we call “Hope”, which achieves superior performance in language modeling and demonstrates better long-context memory management than existing state-of-the-art models.
research.subject: nested_learning_hope

research.name: sdft self distillation
research.snippet: In sequential learning experiments, SDFT enables a single model to accumulate multiple skills over time without performance regression, establishing on-policy distillation as a practical path to continual learning from demonstrations.
research.subject: sdft_self_distillation

research.name: sdpo
research.snippet: Finally, applying SDPO to individual questions at test time accelerates discovery on difficult binary-reward tasks, achieving the same discovery probability as best-of-k sampling or multi-turn conversations with 3x fewer attempts.
research.subject: sdpo

rungs.description: A frontier system passes a public benchmark for knowing an organisation the way a six-month employee would.
rungs.name: Six-month-employee test passed
rungs.observables: the benchmark exists and a frontier system passes it
